user.title: TrainingAssistant
user.description: Set up TrainingAssistant. No devices are needed: buttons and voice satellites are connected later via automations.

abort.single_instance_allowed: Already configured. Only a single configuration possible.

init.title: Voice and light
init.description: The satellite is normally passed when a workout is started by voice. The default satellite is used for workouts started from a button or dashboard.

data.ask_after_set: Ask for reps/weight after each set

data_description.ask_after_set: Pressing the button during the question means 'as planned'.
data_description.question_timeout: No usable answer: the set is stored as 'unconfirmed' and can be fixed in the card.
data_description.notify_service: Notify service (e.g. mobile_app_…) for the end of rest and new records. Empty = off.
data_description.default_light: Optional. Shows the phase as a colour: green while training, yellow during rests, red in the last seconds before you go, gold for a new record. Afterwards the light returns to how it was.
data_description.satellite_light: Without a light above: use a light on the satellite's device, e.g. the LED ring of the Voice PE.

start.name: Start workout
start.description: Starts a workout. Without plan/workout the next workout in rotation is used.

satellite.name: Satellite
satellite.description: Assist satellite for announcements and questions.

device_id.name: Device ID
device_id.description: Device of the satellite, e.g. {{ trigger.device_id }} in a voice automation.

speak_intro.name: Speak intro
speak_intro.description: Off when the intro is returned as conversation response instead.

light.name: Light
light.description: RGB light for the light signal (optional; otherwise the light from the options or the satellite's light).

next.name: Next
next.description: Set done / continue (like the button). Optionally with the actual values of the set – then without a question. Starts the next workout when idle.

effort.name: Effort
effort.description: How the set felt: easy, normal or hard. Hard = no increase next time, all easy = bigger step.

undo.name: Undo
undo.description: Go back one step and discard the set logged there.

skip.name: Skip
skip.description: Skip the current set, or the whole block if it has not started.

finish.name: Finish workout
finish.description: Saves the workout and selects the next one.

abort.name: Abort workout
abort.description: Ends the workout without moving to the next one.

import_plan.name: Import plan
import_plan.description: Imports a training plan in YAML/JSON (format version 1). A plan with the same name is replaced.

plan.name: Plan
plan.description: Plan text in YAML or JSON.

delete_plan.name: Delete plan
delete_plan.description: Deletes a plan. History is kept.

log_set.name: Log set
log_set.description: Sets values for the open question or the last set, e.g. from your own voice automation.

effort.name: Effort
effort.description: How the set felt: easy, normal or hard. Hard = no increase next time, all easy = bigger step.

effort.name: Effort
effort.description: How the set felt: easy, normal or hard. Hard = no increase next time, all easy = bigger step.

get_history.name: Get history
get_history.description: Returns past workouts and suggestions per exercise.

adjust.name: Adjust current set
adjust.description: Changes reps (seconds for timed sets) or weight of the current set by steps. Used by 'Set done'.

set_value.name: Set value of current set
set_value.description: Sets reps (seconds for timed sets) or weight of the current set.

set_program.name: Switch program
set_program.description: Switches the active program. Continues with the workout where you left off.

rest_adjust.name: Adjust rest
rest_adjust.description: Extends or shortens the running rest timer.

set_profile.name: Switch person
set_profile.description: Who is training? Every person has their own history, suggestions and program position. Not possible during a workout.

profile.name: Person
profile.description: Name or ID of the person.

get_stats.name: Get statistics
get_stats.description: Week, streak, training time, sets per muscle group, recovery and recent records of the active person.

no_plan.message: No training plan yet – please import a plan first

already_running.message: A workout is already running – finish or abort it first

no_active_set.message: There is no running set that can be adjusted

no_sets_yet.message: No set has been logged in this workout yet

profile_busy.message: Finish or abort the running workout before switching person

profile_delete_active.message: The active person cannot be deleted – switch to someone else first

user_not_found.message: This Home Assistant user does not exist
